{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Filter for CONTROL-arm patients with MODERATE severity
c_control_moderate = data[(data['arm'] == 'control') & (data['severity'] == 'moderate')]

# Check the number of patients in this group
n_total = len(c_control_moderate)

# Check how many responded
n_responded = c_control_moderate['responded'].sum()

# Calculate fraction
fraction_responded = n_responded / n_total

# Print results
print(f"Total CONTROL-arm, MODERATE: {n_total}")
print(f"Responded: {n_responded}")
print(f"Fraction responded: {fraction_responded}")"}
